_comment: Coverage handoff for COVERAGE: pipeline schema v2. obligations_coverage maps epic-ref obligations_proposed[]. checks[].obligation_ids[]. Contract: docs/coverage-obligation-contract.json.

sources.note: bitbucket_repo: COVERAGE trigger repo= overrides epic-ref sources.bitbucket_repo and docs/project.json bitbucket.default_repo; see .cursor/pipelines/coverage.md phase 1. EPIC-PREP may populate epic-ref repo and implementation.hits for merge in phase 7.

_epic_verification_focus.statement: 1–3 sentences: what this epic primarily verifies (Jira narrative wins over broad requirement branching unless focus= override).

_coverage_matrix_item._verification_role: primary: top-level checks; supporting: detail lines or one contrast subsection; out_of_epic: explicitly_out_of_scope only, no top-level - for this row alone
_coverage_matrix_item.notes_from_epic: verbatim or paraphrase from Jira table/scenarios

_checks_item.scenario_line: - [KEY] One observable outcome (platform prefix if needed)
_checks_item._ambiguity: If set: { flag: '!', reason: 'not enough context | ambiguous spec | ...' } — model must not use vague TBD on executable lines.
_checks_item._verification_role_check: Mirror dominant matrix row; phase 12: top-level - with only supporting/out_of_epic → treat as ungrounded to epic focus unless justified
_checks_item._calculation_contract: metrics_calculation: ladder_present = executable preconditions + expected relation on primary metric; deferred_ambiguous = ! reason instead

_excluded_checks_with_reason_item.reason: explicitly_out_of_scope | ambiguity_flag | analysis_gap | user_map_only | obligation_deferred | other

_by_check_id_item._status_note: Use ungrounded when check is misaligned with epic_verification_focus (e.g. top-level - for out_of_epic-only branch); note in validation_log step 12

_smart_checklist_markdown: Full markdown for Jira Smart Checklist; duplicate of sibling <KEY>-coverage.md body.
